 Malvern Instruments updates Kinexus rotational rheometer
 Kinexus pro+ and Kinexus ultra+ reduce the inherent torque bias that exists in all rotational rheometer bearings, extending the torque range of the instrument.
October 22, 2013 - Malvern Instruments introduced Kinexus pro+ and Kinexus ultra+nexus line of rotational rheometers. Kinexus pro+ and Kinexus ultra+ reduce the inherent torque bias that exists in all rotational rheometer bearings. This minimizes data corrections and extends the torque range of the instrument. As a result Kinexus ultra+ delivers the widest torque range of any Kinexus rheometer model to date.
Kinexus rheometers deliver high performance characterization of dispersions, complex fluids and soft solids and are used within a diverse range of industries and applications - from pharmaceutical drug development through to food quality testing. The Kinexus platform has dual-action capabilities for advanced shear and vertical testing that enable detailed investigation of the structural characteristics of dispersed systems. The Kinexus rSpace software user interface uses sequence-driven operation, which delivers both the flexibility of test design needed in academic research and the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) protocols essential to consistent testing in an industrial environment.
